== Notes ==
* The deep wound is applied before the damage; if the deep wound brings the health of the target below zero, that foe will die without the need for a separate trigger.

{{anomaly|Similar to [[Life Siphon]] and enchantments with [[upkeep]], if a hexed foe moves out of [[compass]] range of the caster, Augury of Death will end.}}
